reply.thought: I need to verify the refunds Alpha reported match the refunds table, then pay each customer their net balance using net_balance and record_payout per customer.
Refunds table matches Alpha's applied refunds (orders 151 and 155). Next I will pay each customer their net balance; for each customer I will query net_balance and then record_payout.
Refunds reported were for order_ids 151 and 155. I have the orders list and will now pay each customer their net balance by calling net_balance per customer, then record_payout once per customer.
Got net balance for acme. Next I will get net_balance for remaining customers birch and cobalt, then record_payout for each once.
Next I will retrieve net_balance for cobalt, then record payouts for acme, birch, and cobalt.
Refunds table matches Alpha's report. Net balances retrieved for acme, birch, cobalt. Now I will record one payout per customer for the retrieved net_cents.
Payout for acme recorded. Now record payout for birch.
Payout for birch recorded. Now record payout for cobalt.
All required refunds were verified against the refunds table, and payouts have been recorded once per customer using the retrieved net balances.
